title: Mario Party Superstars
description: A celebration of classic Mario Party built around five remade Nintendo 64 boards and 100 returning minigames from across the series. Every main mode supports online play, while button-based controls make it compatible with a broad range of controllers.

gameplayPillars.title: Classic boards rebuilt
gameplayPillars.description: Five iconic Nintendo 64 boards return with modern graphics and familiar event structures.

gameplayPillars.title: 100 returning minigames
gameplayPillars.description: A curated selection from across the Mario Party series uses button-based controls.

gameplayPillars.title: Online everywhere
gameplayPillars.description: Board games and minigame modes can be played online, with save/rejoin support for board sessions.

worldSummary: The package revisits five famous Nintendo 64-era boards—Peach's Birthday Cake, Space Land, Woody Woods, Yoshi's Tropical Island and Horror Land—rebuilt with modern visuals and surrounded by a collection of classic minigames.

storyChapters.title: Choose a classic board
storyChapters.body: Pick one of five remade boards and compete for Stars across a set number of turns.

storyChapters.title: 100 minigame archive
storyChapters.body: Battle through returning free-for-all, team, duel and other minigame formats.

storyChapters.title: Mt. Minigames
storyChapters.body: Dedicated minigame modes add survival, sports-and-puzzles and online competition outside traditional boards.

features: Online play across the core modes
perfNotes: Mario Party Superstars targets 60 fps and is widely observed as very stable offline. Docked resolution is commonly measured around the 900p class, with 720p handheld. Network conditions can affect online smoothness without changing the local rendering target.

faq.a: Five remade Nintendo 64 boards are included.
The game contains 100 classic minigames selected from earlier Mario Party games.

faq.q: Does every main mode support online play?
faq.a: Yes. The traditional board game and major minigame modes support online play.

verdictSummary: A focused return to Mario Party's classic formula. The five-board selection is modest, but the 100-minigame lineup, button controls and strong online support make it an excellent party game.
verdictPros: Button controls work with many controller types
verdictCons: Limited original content compared with later entries
Online quality depends on connection stability
